messages:
maya: Kicking off twilight shift cutover — US -> EU -> APAC. @raj @sara confirm warm pools + pinned capacity. Release notes here: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-cutover :eyes:
raj: US warm pool at 125% baseline, canary slice set to 5%. EU pinned to v2.4.0 for canary, +15% capacity reservation. APAC warmup delayed; nodes booting (ETA ~10m).
sara: Confirm EU pin and dashboards up. I muted autoscale surge for first 15m in EU to avoid noisy scale events. Monitoring QoE traces now.
chen: APAC node group passed health checks; initializing smoke job. Thermal headroom at 20% on APAC GPUs.
deploy-bot: deploy start | release=2026-03-cutover | regions=[us, eu, apac] | canary=5% | rollout=sequential | initiated_by=@maya
maya: Roll order: US -> 20m observe -> EU pin & 10m -> APAC ramp. Rollback triggers: sustained p50>300ms x3m, error rate spike >3% x3m, or regional thermal >=85%. On trigger: immediate pinback and notify.
ops-oncall: PD escalation set for EU/APAC. Added mitigation snippet: `if thermal>=85% -> set canary=0 -> drain new instances -> route to fallback-model`.
raj: US canary smoke passed. Example: `curl -s -XPOST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` -> 200 in 110ms. Logs clean.
sara: Watching metrics. Small 429 spike at minute 6 in US for ~30s, auto-retry recovered.
chen: APAC smoke starting:
```
kubectl --context=apac-prod run smoke --image=smoke/test:latest --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/sh -c 'python smoke.py --endpoint https://apac.redwood'
```
chen: Smoke passed (3/3). Starting 2% traffic ramp now.
maya: Reminder EU pin intentional for regression gating. Sara run eval at 5% traffic.
sara: Will run eval at 5% and 10% and post diffs.
deploy-bot: region-update | us:canary=5%:ok | eu:canary=0%:pending-pin | apac:canary=2%:ok
maya: EU ramping to 5% (pinned). Watch NLU drift dashboards.
raj: EU 5% smoke OK. Latency p50 150ms p95 320ms.
sara: Eval(5%) done: quality delta +0.8% (within threshold). Running eval(10%) after stability.
ops-oncall: Thermal snapshot: EU 60%, APAC 28%, US 45%. No action.
maya: After 20m hold, EU -> 20% then APAC gradual to 20% for 2h then scale.
chen: APAC to 5% complete. p50 210ms p95 470ms. Monitoring.
raj: US saw short backpressure event at min 23 on long-sequence route; reduced canary to 3% for 5m and enabled throttle, cleared. No rollback.
maya: Noted. Action recorded: reduce canary 2% -> enable long-seq throttle -> observe 10m.
sara: Eval(10%) results: quality delta +1.6%. No alerts.
deploy-bot: rollout-status | us:stable | eu:canary=20% | apac:canary=5% | overall:progressing
maya: Proceeding with EU full cutover after hold. APAC capped at 20% for first 2h. If stable, continue ramp.
ops-oncall: Fallback route ready: `route/weight { new:0, old:100 }` to apply if rollback needed.
chen: APAC p95 trending down to 360ms after cache warm.
raj: No further US anomalies. Let's retro 30m after cutover for long-seq throttle followup.
maya: Agreed. If rollback required, follow rollback-rapid-pin playbook and PD. Otherwise close window at +2h. Great work team :tada:
